title: CerebroHive Evidence Schema v2
description: Immutable contract for every assurance evidence entry. Schema version is locked — future evolution happens through new schema versions, never by mutating this file. Historical evidence validated against the schema version present at time of recording remains valid forever.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Increment when adding required fields; old evidence retains its original schemaVersion and remains valid.

controlId.description: Unique control identifier matching the descriptor.

status.description: PROVEN = both control and break test passed. PASS = control passed, break test not applicable. BLOCKED = dependency failed. INCONCLUSIVE = ran but evidence too weak to confirm.

failureClass.description: Typed failure classification. Null when status is PROVEN or PASS. Enables actionable routing: ARCHITECTURE_FAILURE reopens the relevant ADR; ENVIRONMENT_FAILURE triggers an ops alert; BLOCKED shows the dependency chain.

runnerVersion.description: Semver of tools/assurance/runner.mjs that produced this evidence. Enables replay: given the same runner version + commit + descriptor, results must be identical.

descriptorHash.description: SHA-256 of the control descriptor JSON at time of execution. If the descriptor changes between runs, the hash mismatch is visible in the evidence chain.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of evidence recording (alias for completedAt, kept for v1 compatibility).

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when control execution began.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when control execution finished (including break test).

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds from startedAt to completedAt.

environment.description: Execution environment. Evidence from 'ci' is authoritative for CEC computation; 'local' evidence is informational only.

gitSha.description: Full 40-character git SHA of the commit under test.

branch.description: Git branch name at time of execution.

runId.description: GitHub Actions run ID, or 'local-{timestamp}' for local runs.

runNumber.description: GitHub Actions run number. 0 for local runs.

runUrl.description: Direct link to the GitHub Actions run. Null for local runs.

workflow.description: GitHub Actions workflow name, or 'manual' for local runs.

actor.description: GitHub username who triggered the run, or 'unknown' for local runs.

details.description: Human-readable description of what was observed. Rendered on the dashboard and in PR comments.

breakTestProven.description: True when a deliberate break of the control was injected and confirmed to produce a FAIL before the control was restored. Satisfies the requirement that 'correct by inspection' is insufficient — the control must demonstrably fail when violated.

breakTestDetails.description: Description of the break test performed, e.g. 'Injected const x: string = 42 → tsc exited 1 → error removed → tsc exited 0'.

artifacts.description: Artifacts produced by or referenced by this control execution. Every evidence entry should have at least one artifact that can be retrieved and independently verified.

evidenceKind.description: Evidence quality classification from tools/harness/evidence.mjs. A PASS backed by static-analysis is weaker than one backed by production-telemetry.

confidence.description: Derived from evidenceKind per the CONFIDENCE map in evidence.mjs.

previousHash.description: SHA-256 of the previous evidence entry for this control in the same environment. Null for the first entry. Forms a hash chain: tampering with any historical entry breaks the chain.

currentHash.description: SHA-256 of this evidence entry (computed over all fields except currentHash and signature). Stored here for convenience — verifiers recompute it and compare.

signature.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 signature using ASSURANCE_SIGNING_KEY. Null when signing is not configured. When present, verifying the signature proves the entry was written by a runner that held the key.
